J-20.name: Chengdu J-20 single-seat baseline
features: paired forebody canards ahead of broad delta main wings
J-20.evidence_scope: gross external layout; user corpus illustration visually checked; no exact proportions certified
J-20.topology: Fore-to-aft: cockpit, small canards, broad swept delta wings, twin fins/nozzles; canards remain visibly separate ahead of main wings.

J-35A.name: Shenyang J-35A single-seat land-based variant
J-35A.evidence_scope: public gross layout plus sample visual; no production block details
J-35A.topology: Fore-to-aft: cockpit, trapezoidal main wings, smaller rear tailplanes, twin fins/nozzles; never add forward canards.

kinetic_grid.name: 冷色技术动势
kinetic_grid.field: Navy upper perspective grid field, diagonal cyan lower streak field, sparse electric-lime lines.
kinetic_grid.layout: Aircraft crosses the field boundary; integrated lower-left label.
kinetic_grid.lettering: Condensed slanted navy glyphs, thin cyan edge, lower-left.
kinetic_grid.stitch: Directional flat fills, narrow lime rim.

cloud_ink.name: 蓝白云染动势
cloud_ink.field: Pale blue/off-white cloud-dyed ground; irregular ultramarine mixed-thread islands, not uniform racing stripes.
cloud_ink.palette: pale blue/off-white dominate; navy aircraft shadows; tiny amber exhausts
cloud_ink.layout: Aircraft travels toward open pale space; integrated lower-right label.
cloud_ink.lettering: Condensed blue glyphs with thin pale edge, lower-right.
cloud_ink.stitch: Fine mixed-thread cloud fields, flat aircraft fills, slim navy rim.

red_charge.name: 红橙冲刺
red_charge.field: Red ground; narrow amber/ivory diagonal trails behind the aircraft, irregular crimson counterforms.
red_charge.palette: red/crimson dominate; silver-gray aircraft, charcoal shadows, amber accent
red_charge.layout: Aircraft crosses the red field; integrated lower-edge label.
red_charge.lettering: Slanted ivory glyphs, thin dark-red edge, lower diagonal.
red_charge.stitch: Flat directional thread regions; slim red rim.
red_charge.forbidden: copied slogans, ring nose intake, copied vintage wings

night_contrast.name: 夜色剪影
night_contrast.field: Near-black ground, two graphite counterforms, selected cyan outer edges; deep interior shadow masses.
night_contrast.palette: black/graphite, cyan highlights, navy aircraft shadow
night_contrast.layout: Long oblique silhouette; integrated lower-left cyan label.
night_contrast.lettering: Tall condensed cyan glyphs, narrow dark offset, lower-left.
night_contrast.stitch: Low-relief fills, selective satin contours, slim charcoal rim.

poses.dorsal_left: Nose upper-left; shallow side/dorsal three-quarter, long slim fuselage; near wing below the spine, far wing shortened above it.
poses.dorsal_right: Nose upper-right; shallow side/dorsal three-quarter, long slim fuselage; near wing below the spine, far wing shortened above it.

common.carrier: Single point-up hexagonal cloth patch; slim stitched rim.
common.simplification: Draw a flat textile illustration first: three dominant color masses, a small canopy mark; omit panel seams and rivets. Thread follows each plane, without sculpted bevels.
common.hierarchy: Aircraft spans roughly 75% width; retain long slim proportions; model lettering occupies roughly 15% height.
common.presentation: White studio background, whole patch front-facing, soft contact shadow, square image.
common.avoid: miniature jet on fabric, extra aircraft silhouettes, thick piping, molded relief, extra text
